lines.speaker: kell
lines.text: Two gate relays control the canal barrier. Break both and I can open the old maintenance exit.

lines.speaker: nyx
lines.text: Pursuit doctrine funnels fugitives into the center lane.

lines.speaker: reyes
lines.text: Fuel is low. We do not stay for a heroic last stand.

lines.speaker: vale
lines.text: Relays, gate, extraction. Nothing else matters.

lines.speaker: kell
lines.text: Gate closed behind you. Search drones will lose the track for a few hours.

lines.speaker: nyx
lines.text: A few hours is the first luxury we have had.

lines.speaker: reyes
lines.text: I know an abandoned quarry outside the official grid.

lines.speaker: vale
lines.text: Then that is home until it is not.

lines.speaker: nyx
lines.text: They sealed the canal. We need to hit the relays faster on the next attempt.

midBattle.speaker: kell
midBattle.text: Relays are upline. Extraction remains locked until both are down.

midBattle.speaker: nyx
midBattle.text: Missile carrier on the floodwall. Government expects us to bunch at the gate.

midBattle.speaker: reyes
midBattle.text: First relay dead. The gate motors are fighting the lock.

midBattle.speaker: kell
midBattle.text: Both relays are down. South-west maintenance exit is open now.

midBattle.speaker: vale
midBattle.text: All units through. Close the gate behind us.
